title: Cookie-less clients
trainingLabel: Training rehearsal - synthetic data - not a live Azure result
objective: Remove browser cookies from an API/mobile trace and preserve independent bearer subjects, v2 routing, complete work state and original request budgets.
preconditions: Two distinct synthetic client baselines already observed on v1; both destinations are assumed available.
Synthetic bearer verification markers and optional browser-cookie records are declared fixtures, not real authentication.
One modern JavaScript browser; no server, accounts, credentials or subscription.
actions: Choose cookie presence, identity rule, routing rule, state location and observation condition.
Rehearse one deterministic handoff and inspect all nine measured checks and before/after traces.
Reset to the default cookie-less configuration and an untested current result while retaining every prior record.
Compare cookie assumptions, local-state loss, delayed responses, rejected bearer fixtures and missing observations.
expectedAssertions: Absent cookies plus bearer identity, cookie-independent API policy and shared subject state passes nine checks.
Cookie-dependent identity or routing fails without cookies.
HTTP 200 does not hide instance-local work loss or original-budget overruns.
With the bearer identity rule, invalid synthetic markers remain rejected, including when browser-cookie fixtures exist.
Missing mobile observations or browser-only traces are unknown, never positive cookie-less evidence.
A known failed check dominates unknown checks without discarding them.
Invalid inputs, stale commands and exhausted budgets cannot mutate prior evidence.

limits.concurrency: One synchronous operator; no timing, network or concurrent-writer measurement.
limits.retention: In-memory page lifetime only; reset retains history and does not replenish the twelve-run budget.
